Definition: from G2310; to lay a basis for, i.e. (literally) erect, or (figuratively) consolidate:--(lay the) found(- ation), ground, settle.
BiblicalUsage: Scripture uses themelióō where it means to lay a foundation, to ground. In Matthew 7:25, the rain descended. Its 5 occurrences all press in the same direction.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that being grounded is not my achievement but God’s work of settling me on what cannot move. That is why themelióō stays with me long after the verse is closed.
